author: Hangtwowho
title: Unreliable during the most crucial moments
review_text: When it is good it is flawless. But there have been far too many moments where a transaction has been denied in a crucial moment. I literally missed a package that took 15 days to deliver to my house right outside my house because esewa failed to provide me access to my own money. It will be reliable in daily life, but there will be a moment when it will fail you in your most crucial hour. It might not happen immediately but it will happen. Absolutely blood-boiling.

author: Aarif rayen

review_text: eSewa has been very unreliable for payments. Many times, the payment simply doesn’t work when I need it, which is frustrating and inconvenient. I expect a digital payment service to be fast, stable, and dependable. Please fix these payment issues and improve the service.
